jobs.title: Accounting Expert: AI Model Evaluation
jobs.description:
About Huzzle Labs

Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance.

About the Role

Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance.

This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.

jobs.company: Ilias Vassiliou & Team / headhunter.digital / Recruiting für Digital, Sales, IT, KI, Automation
jobs.description:
Du bringst die richtigen Unternehmen zusammen und entwickelst daraus erfolgreiches SaaS-Geschäft?

Hier kannst du ein Partnernetzwerk aufbauen, das neue Kunden gewinnt und messbar zum Wachstum beiträgt. Du gestaltest die Channel-Sales-Strategie, gewinnst passende Partner und sorgst dafür, dass die Zusammenarbeit im Alltag funktioniert.

Du kannst zusätzlich Beziehungen zu börsennotierten AGs aufbauen, denn alle Unternehmen ab SDAX aufwärts gehören zur Kernzielgruppe (und teils schon bestehenden Nutzerbasis) unseres Mandanten.

Du bist also Channel Sales Manager und Marktgestalter:in in einem und trägst entscheidend dazu bei, die Nutzung einer führenden Corporate Reporting SaaS-Plattform im DACH-Markt und perspektivisch im europäischen Raum weiter auszubauen.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant
jobs.description:
Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien.

Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging.

Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit.

Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties.

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer - World Map
jobs.description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Build a new kind of certification company

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About the job

About Calibre

AI systems are moving from proof of concepts into the infrastructure of everyday life. That creates a fundamental technical problem: how do you know an increasingly autonomous AI system is secure, reliable and behaving as intended? And who do you trust to answer that question?

The institutions and processes we rely on to provide that confidence were built for a slower, more predictable world. AI is advancing faster than the mechanisms we use to trust it.

Calibre is building trust for the AI era as the first AI-native certification body. We develop core technologies to understand AI and cybersecurity risk, and use them to independently assess companies against leading standards.

Founded by two ex-Palantir technical co-founders, and a founding team spanning audit and AI research, we are pushing the frontier of what trust looks like for the AI economy. We’ve raised $3.3M from top tier SF based VCs.
